meta.title: 4don Portfolio
meta.subtitle: A documented journey from idea → structure → scalable project platform

chapters.title: Motivation
body: The 4don Portfolio was created to not only showcase projects, but to document how they came to life.
Instead of focusing solely on results, this platform highlights motivation, learning processes and decisions.

chapters.title: Initial State
body: At the beginning, the portfolio consisted of static pages with manually maintained content.
As the number of projects grew, it became clear that this structure would not scale.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.text: Separate layout and content (HTML vs. JSON)

steps.label: Step 2
steps.text: Generate project overview from a central JSON file

chapters.title: Internationalization (i18n)
body: All content is organized in language-specific content folders.
The active language is resolved via URL, localStorage and browser fallback.
